prd.title: Inbox List
prd.overview: The Inbox List is Priya's ranked incident inbox with filter chips, row-level reporter-badge chips, and missing-evidence chips. Sort priority-first / age-second. URL persistence of filter state. Drill-into-detail via row → /inbox/:id (WO-005). Tier 3 (light) — reconciliation of existing file to spec.

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/InboxList.tsx (454 LOC); URL persistence of filter state; pagination

requirement.title: Mount route at /inbox for utility_operator
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for utility_operator.

acceptance.criterion: Route renders for utility_operator
Non-operator roles redirect

requirement.title: Priority-first / age-second sort
requirement.description: Sort incidents P1 > P2 > P3 > P4, then ascending age. Same contract as OperatorDashboard (WO-004) and FieldQueue (WO-006).

acceptance.criterion: P1 row above P2 row at same age
Older row first within same priority

requirement.title: Filter chips (priority, band, reporter-badge, status, date range)
requirement.description: Render filter chips: priority (multi-select P1-P4), band (multi-select T1/T2/T3/resolved), reporter-badge (multi-select), status (open/in-flight/resolved), date range picker.

acceptance.criterion: All five filter chips render and function
Each chip is interactive (verified by click/keyboard)

requirement.title: Filter chip URL persistence
requirement.description: Filter chip state serialises to URL query string. Loading URL params pre-populates chip state. Round-trips correctly.

acceptance.criterion: Setting chip updates URL
Loading URL populates chip state
Round-trip serialisation preserves all chip values

requirement.title: Per-row composition (band + reporter + age + missing-evidence)
requirement.description: Each row renders: BandPill (glyph + text), reporter-badge chip, age, missing-evidence chips. Trust band and reporter badge as independent DOM elements per foundation §6.2.

acceptance.criterion: All four row elements render in order
Band and reporter chips are independent DOM elements

requirement.title: Pagination via Pagination primitive
requirement.description: Render Pagination primitive from web/src/components/ui/. Page size fixed at 20 (deferred config to Phase 1.7+).

acceptance.criterion: Pagination primitive used (no custom pagination)
Page size = 20

requirement.title: Empty / loading / error states
requirement.description: Render empty state when filtered list has 0 rows; loading state during fetch; error state on fetch failure. All use Card + appropriate icon + localized message.

acceptance.criterion: Empty state renders when filter has 0 matches
Loading state renders during fetch
Error state renders on fetch failure with retry affordance

requirement.title: Row click navigates to /inbox/:id (WO-005)
requirement.description: Click any row → navigate to /inbox/:incident_id (InboxDetail per WO-005). Mouse + keyboard (Enter) both supported.

acceptance.criterion: Row click navigates to detail page
Enter key on focused row also navigates

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: inbox-list-page, …-header, …-main, …-filter-chips, …-chip-priority, …-chip-band, …-chip-reporter-badge, …-chip-status, …-chip-date-range, …-incident-list, …-row, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-pagination.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for filter chip labels, pagination labels, empty/loading/error messages. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

acceptance.criterion: EN + BN key sets match
No Hindi keys present

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm sort + URL persistence
requirement.description: Verify sort + URL persistence against pre-lockdown code; verify no Hindi strings; verify Pagination primitive used (not custom).

acceptance.criterion: Sort test passes (priority-first / age-second)
URL round-trip test passes
grep 'hi' locale returns zero hits

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Seed mixed priorities + ages; assert rendered order. Sort correct.
Set chips; assert URL update. Reload; assert chips populated. URL persistence round-trips.
Seed empty list; assert empty state. Mock loading; assert loading state. Mock error; assert error state. All three states render.
